July 6, 1972
Mr. John Wellborn Urban and Federal Affairs 1312 Andrew Jackson State Office Building Nashville, Tennessee 37219
Dear John:
This is in reference to our evaluation of the BOR draft Environmental Impact Statement on Executive Order 11644 concerning the use of motorized off-road vehicles.
Our people in Game Management have reviewed this Statement and agree with the acceptance of Executive Order 11644 and believes the only alternative to consider is number VIII-D as noted on page 31 which would be the same as proposed action.
We appreciate the opportunity to review this Statement.
Sincerely,
Harold E. Warvel, Assistant Director
HEN:bt Tennessee Game and Fish Commission
